name: Vinpearl Resort & Spa Phu Quoc
description: Welcoming guests with its bright red tiles, Indochine-style architecture, and an outdoor swimming pool of nearly 5,000m2, Vinpearl Resort & Spa Phu Quoc offers a fun-filled journey with typical natural flavors of the pearl island. Must-try experiences here include savoring a seafood buffet with magnificent sunset views at The Beach Bistro by the sea, enjoying a unique Balinese massage at spa huts above the lake, and conquering thousands of entertainment experiences at VinWonders right nearby.

The quintessence of international cuisine
A variety of culinary options await guests at Vinpearl Resort & Spa Phu Quoc, including international buffets to meet the needs of everyone and fine dining in a luxurious restaurant. Enjoy a delicious seafood dinner at Pepper restaurant with a romantic sea view or sip a tropical cocktail and watch the sunset at Sim Bar and soak in the iridescent sunset.
Seashell Restaurant
Breakfast: 6:00AM – 10:30AM
Lunch: 12:00PM – 2:00PM
Dinner: 6:00PM – 10:00PM
(+84) 297 3550 550
(+84) 297 3550 550
Seashell Restaurant offers a wide range of Asian and European culinary experiences and a fresh buffet with a superb array of the island's finest seafood.
Nemo Restaurant
Breakfast: 6:00AM – 10:30AM
Lunch: 12:00PM – 2:00PM
Dinner: 6:00PM – 10:00PM
(+84) 297 3550 550
(+84) 297 3550 550
Enjoy superb traditional Vietnamese and Southeast Asian dishes alongside an array of modern International cuisine.
The Beach Bistro
12:00AM - 10:00PM
(+84) 297 3550 550
(+84) 297 3550 550
Step into The Beach Bistro and indulge in moments of culinary bliss amid a tropical setting under Phu Quoc’s signature sunset – where local cuisine meets global fusion, and wood-fired pizzas add a delightful touch to the island’s vibrant dining scene.
Pearl Lounge Café
07:00AM – 11:00PM
(+84) 297 3550 550
(+84) 297 3550 550
Bathed in natural light and imbued with Oriental elegance, the Pearl Lounge at Vinpearl Resort & Spa Phu Quoc is a perfect spot for an afternoon tea with live melodies or a relaxing evening rendezvous, featuring a creative and refined menu crafted by a passionate team.
Sim bar
09:00AM – 11:00PM
(+84) 297 3550 550
(+84) 297 3550 550
The most relaxing place to watch sunset on the norht of island. Indulge yourslef in the romantic, relaxing space & modern cocktails while enjoying acoustic music on weekends and joyful music during the weekdays.
Sea view Café
07:00AM – 11:00PM
(+84) 297 3550 550
(+84) 297 3550 550
Seaview Café provides a serene atmosphere to start your day with tea, traditional Vietnamese coffee, and exquisite European pastries.
